items.name: 虚能噬
items.description:
你唤来虚能伤害生命力。目标受到2d4虚能伤害，并进行基础强韧豁免。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。
items.expectedDescription:

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

items.expectedDescription: The beyond terror senses a creature's mental activity as a precise sense within the listed range; it cannot sense mindless creatures with thoughtsense.

items.name: 彼岸恐怖
items.description: 被彼岸惧魔整个吞下的生物，持续承受一整个世界集体、压倒性的存在恐惧所造成的心灵侵袭。它们开始窒息前的轮数减少2轮；逃出后，心智仍艰难地从这场折磨中重新适应，使它们陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}状态1轮。
items.expectedDescription: Creatures Swallowed Whole by the beyond terror are subjected to the constant mental assault of an entire world's collective, crushing existential fear. They have 2 fewer rounds before they begin suffocating, and after their escape, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round as their mind struggles to readjust after the ordeal.

items.name: 无法理解的情感
items.description: 作为纯粹恐惧的实体，彼岸惧魔无法理解其影响领域之外的情感。对抗具有情绪特征、涉及恐惧以外任何情感的法术或效应进行意志豁免时，彼岸惧魔将豁免结果视为比实际掷出的结果差一级。
items.expectedDescription: As an entity of pure fear, the beyond terror cannot comprehend emotions outside its sphere of influence. When attempting Will saves against spells or effects with the emotion trait that deal with any emotion other than fear, the beyond terror treats its saving throw result as one step worse than what it rolls.

items.name: 心灵尖啸
items.description:
彼岸惧魔发出恐怖的心灵尖啸，在@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]内每个有意识的心智中回荡，造成@Damage[3d6[mental]|options:area-damage]伤害。范围内所有能思考的生物必须进行@Check[will|dc:15]豁免。彼岸惧魔在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Psychic Scream]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用心灵尖啸。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物受到一半伤害。

失败该生物受到全额伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}。

大失败该生物受到双倍伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧2}。
items.expectedDescription:
The beyond terror releases a psychic scream of horror that rings through every conscious mind in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30], dealing @Damage[3d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage. All thinking creatures within range must attempt a @Check[will|dc:15] save. The beyond terror cannot use Psychic Scream again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Psychic Scream]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

items.name: 卜筮术
items.description:
你模糊地窥见未来。施放该法术时，询问采取某种特定行动的结果。法术可以预测未来至多30分钟内的结果，并以以下结果呈现GM的最佳判断：吉、凶、吉凶参半（结果有好有坏）或平（没有特别好或特别坏的结果）。

GM秘密进行一次@Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]。失败时，结果总是“平”，使人无法判断“平”是否准确。如果有人在后续施放中询问与首次施放卜筮术相同的主题，GM会使用首次施放时的秘密掷骰结果。不过，如果情况发生变化，也可能得到不同的结果。
items.expectedDescription:
You gain a vague glimpse of the future. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveal the GM's best guess among the following outcomes: good, bad, mixed (the results will be a mix of good and bad), and nothing (there won't be particularly good or bad results).

The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|showDC:all|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of augury during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, though, it's possible to get a different result.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

升阶（6环）你可以制造精英型武器。

升阶（8环）你可以制造终极型武器。

升阶（9环）你可以制造完美型武器。

items.name: 造风术
items.description:
一团暴风从你的掌中喷出，从你施放法术时所在位置直吹到线形终点。这团风吹灭所有小的非魔法火焰，吹散云和雾，吹起负载轻或者更低的物体，并且会推动更大的物体。区域中大型或者更小的生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。在之后进入风中的大型或者更小的生物也必须在进入时尝试该豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物无法顶风移动。

失败 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。如果它在飞行，它改为承受大失败效果。

大失败 该生物被沿风向推离30尺，倒地，并且承受2d6钝击伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you Cast the Spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it was flying, it takes the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

items.name: 治疗术
items.description:
你引导命能来治疗活物或伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿的活物，便为其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，便对其造成等量命能伤害，且其可以进行基础强韧豁免。施放本法术时花费的动作数，决定目标、射程、区域及其他参数。

1该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）法术射程为30尺。如果治疗活物，恢复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能，以爆发范围内所有活物与不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1）治疗量或伤害增加1d8，且两动作版本的额外治疗量增加8。
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

items.name: 重填武器
items.expectedDescription:
You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its expend until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less.

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.
items.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，用魔法能量为其充能。直到你的下一回合结束时，目标会获得与其“耗弹”相等的弹药或充能，并允许任何持有目标的人使用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为使用弹药且弹药价格不超过10个信用点的武器充能。

升阶（3环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的两倍。

升阶（6环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的三倍。

升阶（9环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的四倍。

items.name: 扫描环境
items.expectedDescription:
You analyze the natural environment in the area within 1 mile, learning general information about the atmosphere, biomes, and gravity. You forecast the weather for the next hour, including the direction it will come from; learn which atmospheres, biomes, and gravity are in the area, as well as the direction and distance to those elements; and learn if anything in the area presents an environmental hazard, including cold or heat dangers (at what temperature range), radiation (at what severity), smoke effects, and underwater conditions. This is enough to detect large effects that span spaces over 30 feet in diameter only. You gain a general sense of where and how far away these dangers are.

Heightened (+1) The scanned area increases in radius by 1 mile.
items.description:
你分析1英里范围内的自然环境，了解大气层、生物群落和重力的一般信息。预测未来一小时的天气，包括天气自哪而来；了解该区域有哪些大气、生物群落和重力，以及与这些元素的方向和距离；了解该区域是否存在环境危害，包括冷热危险（在什么温度范围）、辐射（严重程度）、烟雾效果和水下条件。这足以探测到直径超过30英尺的大型效果。你可以大致了解这些危险的位置和距离。

升阶（+1）扫描范围增加1英里。

items.name: 移变激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]
items.description:
你释放出一股魔法能量，暂时改变目标武器造成的伤害类型。使用该武器的下一次打击会造成酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰、音波中由你选择的一种伤害类型，并且额外造成1d6伤害，类型为武器正常的伤害类型。

升阶（+2）额外伤害增加1d6。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]

items.name: 稳定伤势
items.description: 生命能量关闭了死亡之门。目标失去@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{濒死}状态，但仍在0点生命值下@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}。
items.expectedDescription: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

items.name: 绍贝德长步枪
items.description:
绍贝德长步枪是一种具有长线膛枪管的火器。其通常安装有一个适用于多种距离目标的多透镜瞄准镜，以及能够调整每发射击的出膛速度和穿透力的上膛机构，是许多绍贝德战士的首选武器。

绍贝德长步枪配有内置消声器，开火时的声音不会比弩更响。

绍贝德长步枪是一种军用武器。
items.expectedDescription:
The shobhad longrifle is a firearm with a long, rifled barrel. Often mounted with a multi-lensed scope for targeting at an array of ranges and a chambering mechanism that can adjust the speed and penetrating power of each shot, it's the preferred weapon of many shobhad warriors.

Shobhad longrifles are equipped with a built-in silencer so they make no more noise than a crossbow when fired.

A shobhad longrifle is a martial weapon.

items.name: 微纤护甲
items.description:
强化： 1

此轻甲以超轻纤维编织，随穿戴者的动作弯曲，但受到冲击时会硬如钢铁。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.

items.name: 商用型消音器
items.expectedDescription: A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.
items.description: 该金属圆筒内填充了隔音材质，能够减少火器发出的噪音。火器开火时不会发出巨大的噪音。不过，被子弹命中的生物还是有可能会因为痛苦而喊叫出声。

items.name: 商用型狙击镜
items.expectedDescription:
A telescopic sighting attachment helps view distant targets.

Activate—Adjust Sight 1 (manipulate)

Effect Increase the range increment of the weapon the scope is attached to by 10 feet. If the weapon has a base range increment of 50 feet or more, increase the range of the weapon by 20 feet instead. This lasts until the beginning of your next turn or until you're no longer wielding the weapon this scope is attached to, whichever comes first. This does not increase the size of area attacks.
items.description:
该望远瞄准装置有助于观察远处目标。

启动—调整准心 1 （操作）

效果 装有此瞄准镜的武器射程增量增加10尺。如果武器的基础射程增量至少为50尺，则改为增加20尺。此效果持续至你的下个回合开始，或直到你不再持用装有此瞄准镜的武器，以先发生者为准。这不会扩大区域攻击的范围。

items.name: 转移命能
items.description: 阿鲁克从命能网络中转移至多@Damage[10[healing]]生命值，给予60尺内一个她能感知的结绊生物。此动作能影响具有虚能治疗的生物，如同具有虚能特征。
items.expectedDescription: Aruk transfers up to @Damage[10[healing]] Hit Points from her vitality network to a bonded creature she can sense within 60 feet. This works on creatures with void healing as though this action had the void trait.

items.name: 光亮术
items.description:
你创造一个光球，以你选择的颜色在20尺半径内发出明亮光照，并在外围20尺内发出昏暗光照。如果在一个自愿生物所在的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球附着于该生物，使其在生物移动时漂浮在其近旁。你可以维持该法术，使光球移动至多60尺；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将光球附着于生物或从生物身上分离。

你可以解消该法术。如果你在你已经有4个光亮术激活时施放该法术的话，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环级） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

items.name: 世界赐福追踪者
items.description: 身处阿基顿时，阿鲁克在探索模式中进行[[/act track]]所需的生存检定自动成功。
items.expectedDescription: While she's on Akiton, Aruk automatically succeeds at Survival checks to [[/act track]] made during exploration mode.

items.name: 命能网络（专长）
items.description: 阿鲁克的命能网络能与至多10名结绊盟友共享。该网络至多储存@Damage[14[healing]]生命值，进入战斗时为满额，每轮恢复@Damage[4[healing]]生命值。
items.expectedDescription: Aruk has a vitality network they share with up to 10 bonded allies. This network can store a maximum of @Damage[14[healing]] Hit Points, begins combat full, and regains @Damage[4[healing]] Hit Points per round.

items.name: 商用型爆燃手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 1d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:5]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击击退5尺

这类手雷点燃化学物质，引发炽热的爆炸，造成1d8点火焰伤害，并进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免（@Template[burst|distance:5]）。如果你可以使用手雷的重击专精效果，对抗燃烧手雷的豁免检定大失败的生物会被推离手雷。

items.name: 联网节点体
items.description: 节点体能与200尺内的其他节点体进行无线通讯。
items.expectedDescription: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

items.name: 阻断去路
items.description:
触发节点体触及内一个生物使用移动动作，或在其使用的移动动作中离开一个方格

效果节点体哨卫对触发生物进行近战打击。命中时，还会打断目标的移动。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within the nodocite's reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect The nodocite sentry makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature. On a hit, the target's movement is additionally disrupted.

items.name: 激光步枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这些可靠的量产步枪从方形枪管射出集中的能量束。协约世界（Pact Worlds）的通用标准型号便于大幅改装，可搭配多种配件与强化模块使用；持用者能依自己的偏好调整激光步枪，甚至混装零件，将其改得几乎面目全非。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These dependable, mass-produced rifles shoot concentrated beams of energy out of square-shaped barrels. The universal standard Pact Worlds model is highly modifiable and designed to function with a variety of accessories and upgrades, with wielders adapting the laser rifle to their preferences and even kit-bashing it into a nearly unrecognizable weapon.

items.name: 念力巨蜥护甲
items.description:
强化： 1

这种由柔韧而坚固的甲片层叠制成的传统护甲，由卡斯卓韦（Castrovel）的拉申塔人（Lashunta）骑兵穿戴。过去，念力巨蜥骑兵（shotalashu cavalry）会用坐骑蜕下的皮，或更少见地用阵亡坐骑的皮制作护甲，以便在今后的战斗中纪念它们。合成仿制品在卡斯卓韦的某些地区颇为流行。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 龙之吐息
items.description: 龙人呼出一道@Template[type:cone|distance:15]的火焰，造成@Damage[2d4[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic]豁免）。其在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dragonkin Breath]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用龙人吐息。
items.expectedDescription: The dragonkin exhales a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] of fire that deals @Damage[2d4[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic] save). They can't use Dragonkin Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dragonkin Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

JvX6eYrXNanEGLUm.name: 冰冻宝库安保专家 Frozen Trove Security Specialist

items.name: 朦胧术
items.description: 目标的形体变得模糊，处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态。但此效应仍使目标的位置显而易见，因此目标不能利用这种隐蔽来躲藏或潜行。
items.expectedDescription: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 解除魔法
items.description: 你瓦解法术或效果背后的魔法。对目标尝试反制检定。如果成功反制一件魔法物品，该物品会变为同类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物品的非魔法属性。如果目标是神器或类似物品，你自动失败。
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.description:
元素能量护盾保护一个生物，使其抵御一种能量伤害。选择强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波伤害。目标及其装备获得对所选伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环）抗力提高至10，且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环）抗力提高至15，且你能以至多五个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.

items.name: 网络筛查
items.description:
你以仪式筛查本地信息圈，获得关于某个主题的秘术洞见。施放本法术期间，询问某一具体行动方案的结果。法术能预知未来至多30分钟内的结果，并揭示GM认为最可能的下列结果之一。

  • 吉结果有利。
  • 凶结果不利。
  • 吉凶参半结果有利有弊。
  • 无结果不会特别有利或不利。GM秘密投掷@Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]。失败时，结果始终为“无”。这使人无法分辨“无”的结果是否准确。如果有人在再次施法时询问与首次网络筛查相同的主题，GM使用首次施法的秘密掷骰结果。如果情况发生变化，也可能得到不同的结果。

升阶（4环）法术能预知未来至多1周内的结果。
items.expectedDescription:
You ritually sift through the local infosphere and gain mystical insight about a topic. During the casting of this spell, ask about the results of a particular course of action. The spell can predict results up to 30 minutes into the future and reveals the GM's best guess among the following outcomes.

  • Weal The results will be good.
  • Woe The results will be bad.
  • Weal and Woe The results will be a mix of good and bad.
  • Nothing There won't be particularly good or bad results. The GM rolls a secret @Check[flat|dc:6|traits:secret]. On a failure, the result is always "nothing." This makes it impossible to tell whether a "nothing" result is accurate. If anyone asks about the same topic as the first casting of sift the sphere during an additional casting, the GM uses the secret roll result from the first casting. If circumstances change, it's possible to get a different result.

Heightened (4th) The spell can predict results up to 1 week into the future.

items.name: 分析目标
items.expectedDescription:
You focus on the target, gathering data as magical holograms display information. When the casting is complete, you learn biometric information about the target, including its fingerprints, medical conditions, and other basic physiological information. You or anyone you advise about the analysis gains a +1 status bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} the creature, to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} on the creature, and to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about it. If the target is illusory or under the effects of illusion magic, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your analyze target spell.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

Heightened (3rd) The status bonus increases to +2, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +3, and you can target any number of creatures.
items.description:
你专注在目标身上，收集数据并以魔法全息图像显示。当施法完成，你会获得目标的所有生物特征信息，包括指纹、医疗状况和其他基本生理信息。你或任何得到你基于分析建议的人，在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]为该生物、对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]、以及对该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]的检定上获得+1状态加值。如果目标是幻觉或者处于幻术魔法效果下，仅当效果的环级低于你分析目标的法术环级，你才能够探测到结果。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

升阶（6环）状态加值提升到+3，并且你可以任意名生物作为目标。

items.name: 晕眩术
items.description:
你侵入目标的心智，以精神冲击使其晕眩。这道冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，目标进行基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+2）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 衰弱术

你抽走目标的力量，具体效果取决于其强韧豁免。

失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭2}，持续1分钟。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭3}，持续1分钟。
items.expectedDescription:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

items.name: 力场飞弹
items.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 讯息传递

items.expectedDescription: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

在本回合结束前，你下次进行攻击检定时掷两次，并采用较好结果。此次攻击忽略攻击检定的环境减值，以及因目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{躲藏}状态而需要进行的任何纯骰检定。之后，你暂时免疫料敌机先10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{法术效果：料敌机先}

The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

items.name: 念动射弹
items.description:
你将射程内一件未固定、无人持有且负载不超过1的物体掷向目标。对目标进行法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害，取决于所掷物体。被掷物品的任何特殊特征或魔法属性，都不会影响此次攻击或伤害。

items.name: 次声谐振
items.description: 晶刺兽发出强力的音波咆哮，造成@Damage[5d6[sonic]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:cone|distance:30]（@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic]豁免）。大失败时，次声频率冲击生物内脏，使其还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}状态。晶刺兽在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Subsonic Harmonics]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用次声谐振。
items.expectedDescription: The quildebeest unleashes a powerful sonic roar that deals @Damage[5d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save). On a critical failure, a creature is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, as the subsonic frequencies batter their internal organs. A quildebeest can't use Subsonic Harmonics again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Subsonic Harmonics]]{1d4 rounds}.

items.name: 电光闪耀
items.description:
触发一名玩家角色进入区域

效果光芒一闪，区域内电流噼啪作响，开始下雨。触发生物受到@Damage[(1d6+2)[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]豁免）。大失败时，该生物还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态，持续1轮。然后，该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A PC enters the area

Effect With a flash of light, the area crackles with electricity, and it begins to rain. The triggering creature is dealt @Damage[(1d6+2)[electricity]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save). On a critical failure, that creature is additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. The hazard then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: An unnatural magical storm appears in the area with a crack of thunder and lightning.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 伴随雷鸣与闪电，一场不自然的魔法风暴出现在区域内。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:13], @Check[nature|dc:13], @Check[occultism|dc:13], or @Check[religion|dc:13] (all trained) to overcome the magical anomaly, or @Check[athletics|dc:16], @Check[survival|dc:16], or @Check[thievery|dc:16] to destabilize the hazard's center point; two total successes are required to disable the hazard.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:13]、@Check[nature|dc:13]、@Check[occultism|dc:13]或@Check[religion|dc:13]（均需受训）以克服魔法异常；或@Check[athletics|dc:16]、@Check[survival|dc:16]或@Check[thievery|dc:16]以使危害的中心点失稳；解除危害总计需要两次成功。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The hazard makes three ranged Strikes against PCs, selecting different targets if possible, beginning with those closest to the hazard's center.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）危害对PC进行三次远程打击，尽可能选择不同目标，从最接近危害中心者开始。

items.name: 命令术
items.description:
你高声发出一道难以忽视的命令。你可以命令目标接近你、逃跑（如同处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}状态）、放开所持物品、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，或站在原地。在服从你的命令之前，它不能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{延迟}，也不能使用任何反应。具体效果取决于目标的意志豁免。

成功该生物不受影响。

失败该生物必须在其下一回合，以第一个动作花费一个单动作服从你的命令。

大失败目标必须用其下一回合的全部动作服从你的命令。

升阶（5环）你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: 晕眩术
items.description:
你侵入目标的心智，以精神冲击使其晕眩。这道冲击造成1d6心灵伤害，目标进行基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}。

升阶（+2）伤害增加1d6。
items.expectedDescription:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.description:
你发出一道感应魔法存在的脉冲。除魔法是否存在外，你不会获得其他信息。你可以选择忽略自己完全知晓的魔法，例如你与盟友的魔法物品和持续中的法术。只有幻术魔法效应的环阶低于你的侦测魔法法术环阶时，你才能侦测到它。不过，具有幻术灵光、但外观并不具有欺骗性的物品（例如隐形药水），通常仍能正常侦测。

升阶（3环）你得知此法术侦测到的最强魔法效应的环阶或等级，由GM决定。

升阶（4环）如同3环，但你还能定位最高环阶魔法的来源。如同不精确感官，你不会得知确切位置，但能将来源缩小至一个5尺立方空间内（若来源更大，则为最近的该大小空间）。
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

items.name: 力场飞弹
items.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

items.name: 心灵穿刺
items.expectedDescription:
You overload a creature's mind with a glut of psychic information or divine judgments. The mental onslaught deals 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
items.description:
你以大量心灵信息或神祇裁决使一个生物的心智超载。心灵冲击造成2d6心灵伤害。大失败时，目标还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}状态，持续1轮。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加 2d6。

items.name: 护盾术
items.description:
你举起一面由力场构成的魔法盾牌。这视为使用举盾动作，给予你AC的+1环境加值，直到你的下一回合开始，但不需要用手。

在法术生效期间，你可以用魔法盾牌使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{盾牌格挡}反应。盾牌具有硬度5。你能使用该法术的反应减少任何法术或魔法效果造成的伤害，即使其并非物理伤害。使用盾牌格挡后，法术结束，且你在10分钟内无法再次施放该法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{法术效果：护盾术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{效果：护盾术免疫}

升阶（+2）盾牌的硬度增加5。
items.expectedDescription:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

items.name: 虚能噬
items.description:
你唤来虚能伤害生命力。目标受到2d4虚能伤害，并进行基础强韧豁免。大失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到你的下一回合开始。

升阶 （+1）伤害增加1d4。
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

items.name: 电击垫
items.description:
强化： 1

这种柔韧的纳米碳电路可以作为强化模块装入手套、护膝或类似的附肢防护装备中，在用力接触目标时释放强力电击。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This flexible nanocarbon circuit can be installed as an upgrade into gloves, kneepads, or similar appendage protectors to emit a powerful electric shock when forcefully applied to a target.

items.name: 硬光套装
items.description:
强化： 1

固定在腰带或翻领上的投影器，用这层闪耀的硬光外壳包裹穿戴者的身体。军用制式硬光护甲遵循固定标准，而私人用户则能享用一系列可定制的时尚款式。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.

items.name: 商用型黑客工具包
items.description: 骇入计算机的计算机检定需要使用黑客工具包。你可以使用黑客工具包来不通过用户界面访问计算机，但这需要与计算机进行物理接触，或通过信息圈或相似的链接网络进行连接。
items.expectedDescription: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network.

items.name: 商用型渗透者工具包
items.description: 你需要渗透者工具包来用贼活技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]（部分类型）。
items.expectedDescription: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

items.name: 商用型修理工具包
items.expectedDescription: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
items.description: 修理工具包包含各种各样的允许你在旅行途中进行简单修理的精密工具和供应品。你可以用修理工具包使用手艺技能修理物品。如果你穿戴着修理工具包，你可以抽出和替换一个穿戴在身上的修理工具包，作为使用动作的一部分。

items.name: 纳米体激增
items.description:
频率每小时一次

触发代码低语尝试一个需要3个或更少动作的技能动作

效果代码低语刺激自身的纳米机器人，迫使身体暂时提高效率。触发技能检定获得+2状态加值。此外，其电路发光，在@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内提供微光，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Whisper in the Code attempts a skill action that takes 3 or fewer actions

Effect Whisper in the Code stimulates their nanites, forcing their body to temporarily increase its efficiency. They gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check. In addition, their circuitry glows, lighting a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] with dim light for 1 round.

items.name: 及远法术
items.description: 如果代码低语的下一个动作是施放具有射程的法术，则将该法术的射程增加30尺。
items.expectedDescription: If the next action Whisper in the Code takes is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet.

items.name: 光亮术
items.description:
你创造一个光球，以你选择的颜色在20尺半径内发出明亮光照，并在外围20尺内发出昏暗光照。如果在一个自愿生物所在的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球附着于该生物，使其在生物移动时漂浮在其近旁。你可以维持该法术，使光球移动至多60尺；作为此次移动的一部分，你可以将光球附着于生物或从生物身上分离。

你可以解消该法术。如果你在你已经有4个光亮术激活时施放该法术的话，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环级） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

items.name: 商用型机械心智血清
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

注射此血清后，魔法科技纳米机器人会在你体内形成机械般的回路，在皮肤下脉动发光。在1分钟内，你在对抗心灵效应的豁免中获得+1物品加值，并获得心灵伤害抗力5。由于你的身体更接近机械，你也获得电击弱点5。
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

When you inject this serum, magitech nanites infuse your body with machine-like circuitry that pulses and glows beneath your skin. For 1 minute, you gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against mental effects. You also gain resistance 5 to mental damage. Due to your more machine-like nature, you gain weakness 5 to electricity.

items.expectedName: +1 to Saves Vs Disease, Mental, Poison, Radiation
items.name: 对抗疾病、心灵、毒素、辐射的豁免+1

NdqOLPOwZ1YweqII.name: 代码低语 Whisper in the Code

cnText_system_attributes_allSaves_value.text: 对抗疾病、心灵、毒素、辐射时+1

items.name: 多重擒持
items.description: 集成体格雷米克能同时使至多4个生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}状态，每个生物各用一条不同的腿擒住。
items.expectedDescription: Gremmik Integrated can have up to 4 creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} at the same time, each with a different leg.

items.name: 神经集成
items.description: 身处归航者残骸内时，集成体格雷米克能与埃洛维进行无线通讯。
items.expectedDescription: Gremmik Integrated can communicate wirelessly with Elovai while within the Wreck of the Returned.

items.name: 腿太多了！
items.description: 集成体格雷米克对触及内每个敌人进行腿打击，至多八个目标。这些攻击受到–2环境减值，但多次攻击减值在这些攻击全部结束后才增加。他无法以这种方式进行的任何腿打击来攫抓。
items.expectedDescription: Gremmik Integrated makes a leg Strike against each enemy within reach, up to a maximum of eight targets. He takes a –2 circumstance penalty on these attacks, but his multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after these attacks are complete. He can't Grab with any leg Strikes made this way.

P7sZxfsmVhDWjvLY.name: 集成体格雷米克 Gremmik Integrated

items.name: 烟花
items.description:
触发等离子企鹅降至0生命值

效果等离子企鹅爆炸成一团烟花，造成@Damage[1d4[electricity],1d4[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]（@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The plasma penguin is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The plasma penguin explodes in a burst of fireworks, dealing @Damage[1d4[electricity],1d4[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic|options:area-effect] save).

items.name: 等离子滑行
items.description: 等离子企鹅卧倒，用肚皮滑行至多两倍速度的距离，然后起立。之后，它可以对触及内一个生物尝试近战打击。
items.expectedDescription: The plasma penguin Drops Prone, moves up to twice its Speed by sliding on its stomach, then Stands. It can then attempt a melee Strike against a creature within reach.

items.name: 共振鹿角
items.description: 魔法振动从库里亚库的鹿角传遍全身。因库里亚库而处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}状态的生物，在开始其回合时必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:14]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}状态，持续1轮（大失败时1小时）。处于束缚状态的生物将结果视为比实际结果差一个成功度。
items.expectedDescription: Magical vibrations resonate through Kuriaku from his antlers. A creature that starts its turn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by Kuriaku must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:14] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round (1 hour on a critical failure). A restrained creature uses the outcome one degree of success worse than its result.

items.name: 凶猪冲锋
items.description: 电控野猪行走两次，然后进行獠牙打击。只要移动了至少20尺，此次攻击检定便获得+2环境加值。
items.expectedDescription: The cy-boar Strides twice and then makes a tusk Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.

items.name: 联网节点体
items.description: 节点体能与200尺内的其他节点体进行无线通讯。
items.expectedDescription: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

items.name: 旋转偏转
items.description:
触发节点体轰击者成为一次它已察觉到的物理攻击的目标

效果节点体轰击者飞速旋转，化作运动的残影，对抗触发攻击的AC获得+2环境加值。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The nodocite blaster is the target of a physical attack they're aware of

Effect The nodocite blaster spins rapidly, becoming a blur of motion and gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

items.name: 闪电喷射
items.description: 节点体轰击者喷射@Template[type:cone|distance:15]的电火花，造成@Damage[3d6[electricity]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription: The nodocite blaster sprays electric sparks in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15], dealing @Damage[3d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|options:area-effect] save).

TUDnG2r3f2YDF0Jx.name: 节点体轰击者 Nodocite Blaster

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你从群星之间的黑暗虚空中凝聚一束侵袭心灵的诡异能量，射向目标。对抗目标的AC进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你造成2d6心灵伤害。大成功时，你造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 重填武器
items.expectedDescription:
You touch a weapon with no remaining ammunition and recharge it with magical energy. The target gains ammunition or charges equal to its expend until the end of your next turn, allowing anyone holding the target to make one Strike with the weapon. This spell only recharges weapons that use ammunition with a cost of 10 credits or less.

Heightened (3rd) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to double its expend.

Heightened (6th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to triple its expend.

Heightened (9th) The target gains ammunition or charges equal to quadruple its expend.
items.description:
你触碰一件没有剩余弹药的武器，用魔法能量为其充能。直到你的下一回合结束时，目标会获得与其“耗弹”相等的弹药或充能，并允许任何持有目标的人使用该武器进行一次打击。该法术只能为使用弹药且弹药价格不超过10个信用点的武器充能。

升阶（3环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的两倍。

升阶（6环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的三倍。

升阶（9环）目标获得的弹药或充能数量等于其消耗量的四倍。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 奥克腾岩飞轮
items.description:
强化： 1

这个带刃圆环由一块奥克顿矿（aucturnite）雕刻而成，造型仿照行星环。此材料神秘地出现在距离奥克顿（Aucturn）原轨道数光年之外的地方。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This bladed hoop is carved from a chunk of aucturnite and sculpted to resemble a planet's ring. The material has mysteriously appeared light-years from Aucturn's original orbit.

items.name: 激光手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把紧凑的手枪因可靠、耐用且价格实惠，成为协约世界（Pact Worlds）最受欢迎的随身武器。大多数普通激光手枪有轻质聚碳枪身，末端连着细长的枪管。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol is the most popular sidearm in the Pact Worlds thanks to its reliability, durability, and affordability. Most common laser pistols have a lightweight polycarbon body ending in a long, slim barrel.

V3J4tYJ2Os58ZRg9.name: 尸骸舰队步兵 Corpse Fleet Infantry
V3J4tYJ2Os58ZRg9.publicNotes:
尸骸舰队的普通步兵都经过协同作战的训练。

尸骸舰队是一支由不死至上主义者组成的军队，拒绝屈从活人的意志。它由伊奥克斯海军的叛逃者建立，意图瓦解协约世界的团结，使伊奥克斯摆脱活人及支持活人的白骨贤者的影响。尸骸舰队顽固不化、冷酷无情，散播死亡与毁灭，吞食活人、利用死者。

items.name: 电弧手枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把笨重的手枪不使用传统弹药，而是内置一个能够产生电弧的电容器。枪托由聚碳材料或其他合成绝缘材料制成，通常染成亮黄色，并刻有表示高压电的通用闪电符号。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.

items.name: 自瞄步枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把短粗的突击步枪内置活塞系统，让使用者能切换至自动射击，扣动一次扳机便倾泻整个弹匣。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This short, bulky assault rifle incorporates a piston system that allows the user to switch to auto-fire and unload a magazine with one trigger squeeze.

items.name: 战斗手套
items.description:
强化： 1

这些耐用手套套在持用者的手上（或其他附肢上），指节处装有配重甲板或尖刺。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These durable gloves fit over a wielder's hands (or other appendages) and feature weighted plates or spikes over the knuckles.

items.name: 战术型骨化手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 2d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，持续1轮

这种手雷由伊奥克斯海军发明，其设计后来被早期尸骸舰队窃取。爆炸时，手雷迅速释放钙化剂，将活体血肉转化为骨骼，造成2d8虚能伤害。以下范围内的活物： @Template[burst|distance:10] 必须尝试一次基础反射豁免。如果你可以使用手雷的重击专精效果，豁免大失败的生物会陷入笨拙。

items.name: 念力巨蜥护甲
items.description:
强化： 1

这种由柔韧而坚固的甲片层叠制成的传统护甲，由卡斯卓韦（Castrovel）的拉申塔人（Lashunta）骑兵穿戴。过去，念力巨蜥骑兵（shotalashu cavalry）会用坐骑蜕下的皮，或更少见地用阵亡坐骑的皮制作护甲，以便在今后的战斗中纪念它们。合成仿制品在卡斯卓韦的某些地区颇为流行。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.

items.name: 齐射
items.expectedDescription: The Corpse Fleet infantry's ranged Strikes deal an additional 1d4 precision damage when the Corpse Fleet infantry is within the first range increment of at least one other member of the Corpse Fleet wielding a ranged weapon.
items.description: 当尸骸舰队步兵处于至少一名持用有远程武器的其他尸骸舰队成员的第一个射程增量内时，其远程打击造成额外1d4精准伤害。

items.name: 协同步移
items.description:
触发一名相邻盟友移离尸骸舰队步兵

效果尸骸舰队步兵行走至多相当于其速度一半的距离，必须与触发盟友朝同一方向移动。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An adjacent ally moves away from the Corpse Fleet infantry

Effect The Corpse Fleet infantry Strides up to half their Speed. They must move in the same direction as the triggering ally.

items.name: 等离子爆能枪
items.description:
强化： 1

这把紧凑的手枪发射凝聚的等离子球。射击前同时按住扳机和保险夹，会让枪管中积聚更多等离子体。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This compact pistol shoots balls of condensed plasma. Holding down the trigger and safety clip at the same time before firing results in the barrel building up more plasma.

items.name: 保温织服
items.description:
强化： 1

温控编织服以保温面料和散热导线织成，是一种经过加固的兜帽服饰，前往卡斯卓韦或普罗尼斯（Pulonis）的丛林等潮湿气候地区旅行时，穿戴它很流行。
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.

extraFields.expected: This series of support braces allow you to carry and lift beyond your normal capacity. You can carry an amount of Bulk equal to 6 plus your Strength modifier without becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk up to 11 plus your Strength modifier.
extraFields.text: 这套支架系统允许你携带与举起超过你正常负重量的物品。你可以携带而不会陷入超载的负载等于6+你的力量调整值，并且你总共可以持有与携带负载等同11+你力量调整值的物品。

items.name: 加大电压！
items.description:
需求齐曾齐的上一个动作是成功的导电棘刺打击

效果齐曾齐提高导电棘刺中的电压，使受伤目标承受极大痛苦。目标必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:19|options:inflicts:sickened]豁免，否则因疼痛陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}状态（大失败时为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}）。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements Zizenzi's last action was a successful conductive spine Strike

Effect Zizenzi amps up the voltage in their conductive spines, causing immense pain to the injured target. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19|options:inflicts:sickened] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} from the pain (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

XytZxY2FixC9e5T9.name: 转化者齐曾齐 Zizenzi Converted

items.name: 现实撕裂者
items.description: 模块化［强酸与拆毁（razing），或虚能与震荡］
items.expectedDescription: modular [acid and razing or void and concussive]

items.name: 集成战术型现实撕裂者
items.description:
这把流线型步枪将能量转化为凝聚魔力的弹体，通过破坏物质与现实的联系来撕裂物质。现实撕裂者采用模块化设计，有毁灭和收割两种模式。毁灭模式下，现实撕裂者造成酸蚀伤害并获得拆毁特征；收割模式下，它造成虚能伤害并获得震荡特征。

现实撕裂者的最低武器强化等级为战术型，因此其追踪+1不能移除，但仍可进行进一步强化。
items.expectedDescription:
This sleek rifle converts energy into projectiles of concentrated magic that tears apart matter by destroying its bindings to the reality. A reality ripper is modular and has two modes: destructive and reaping. While in destructive mode, the reality ripper deals acid damage and gains the razing trait. While in reaping mode, a reality ripper deals void damage and gains the concussive trait.

A realty ripper's minimum weapon improvement is tactical, meaning its tracking +1 cannot be removed, though further improvements can be still applied.

items.name: 联网节点体
items.description: 节点体能与200尺内的其他节点体进行无线通讯。
items.expectedDescription: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

items.name: 曲织波动
items.description:
频率每10分钟一次

触发一个生物以一次攻击将节点体枪手作为目标

效果节点体枪手扭曲自身周围的现实，对抗触发攻击的AC获得+2环境加值。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Trigger A creature targets the nodocite gunner with an attack

Effect The nodocite gunner warps reality around itself, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack.

items.name: 评估目标
items.description: 节点体枪手评估200尺内的一个目标，找出其防御漏洞。直到节点体枪手回合结束，它以现实撕裂者对评估目标额外造成1d8伤害，并将现实撕裂者的射程增量提高至80尺。
items.expectedDescription: The nodocite gunner assesses a target within 200 feet and pinpoints gaps in their defenses. Until the end of the nodocite gunner's turn, they deal an additional 1d8 damage with their reality ripper against the Assessed Target and increase the range increment of their reality ripper to 80 feet.

items.name: 现实牢笼
items.description:
频率每小时一次

效果节点体守卫弯曲现实，将60尺内一个中型或更小生物困在扭曲现实形成的牢笼中。目标必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:20]豁免。

大成功目标不受影响，现实牢笼未能成形。

成功目标受到现实碎片阻碍，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态1轮；现实牢笼未能成形。

失败目标被困在现实牢笼中，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}。

大失败目标被困在现实牢笼中，持续1分钟。现实牢笼具有AC 10、硬度5、10生命值（破损阈值5）。被困在现实牢笼中的生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态（@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}DC 20）。现实牢笼提供次级掩蔽。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The nodocite guardian bends reality to trap one Medium or smaller creature within 60 feet in a cage of warped reality. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:20] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected, and the reality cage fails to form.

Success The target is hindered by reality shards, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round; the reality cage fails to form.

Failure The target is trapped in a reality cage that lasts [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Failure The target is trapped in a reality cage that lasts 1 minute. A reality cage has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 10 Hit Points (BT 5). A creature trapped in a reality cage is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} DC 20). A reality cage provides lesser cover.

items.name: 纳米体修理
items.description:
频率每天一次

效果植入转化刻法克虫体内的纳米机器修复其伤口，使其恢复@Damage[2d6[healing]]生命值。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Effect Nanites implanted in the converted khefak's body repair its wounds, restoring @Damage[2d6[healing]] Hit Points.

items.name: 啃食废料
items.description: 刻法克虫咀嚼一件无人持有的物体进食，每10分钟对该物体造成@Damage[4[piercing]]伤害。此伤害忽略10点硬度。如果刻法克虫每天没有花费至少1小时啃噬废料，便开始饥饿，直到花费10分钟啃噬废料。
items.expectedDescription: A khefak chews on an unattended object to feed, dealing @Damage[4[piercing]] damage every 10 minutes to the object. This damage ignores 10 points of Hardness. If a khefak doesn't spend at least 1 hour Gnawing Scrap per day, it begins to starve until it spends 10 minutes Gnawing Scrap.

items.name: 开沟利齿
items.description:
需求转化刻法克虫在本回合最近的一个动作中以虫颚打击命中

效果转化刻法克虫迅速转动沿虫颚排列的尖锐锯齿，对被其虫颚打击命中的生物造成@Damage[1d10[slashing]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements The converted khefak hit with a mandible Strike on its most recent action this turn

Effect The converted khefak quickly rotates the jagged serrations along its mandibles, dealing @Damage[1d10[slashing]] damage to the creature it hit with its mandible Strike.

ayOJu6R5zjVxiVkw.name: 转化刻法克虫 Converted Khefak

items.name: 致眩麻醉剂
items.description:
豁免检定 @Check[fortitude|dc:13]

最长持续时间 6轮

阶段1@Damage[1[poison]]伤害，并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}（1轮）

阶段2@Damage[1d4[poison]]伤害，并笨拙1（1轮）
items.expectedDescription:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:13]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d4[poison]] damage and clumsy 1 (1 round)

items.expectedDescription: A nodocite can communicate wirelessly with other nodocites within 200 feet.

items.name: 手术突袭
items.description: 节点体实验员挥舞手术刀，迅速而狂乱地攻击与其相邻的所有生物，对触及范围内所有生物造成@Damage[1d4[slashing]]伤害，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic]豁免。
items.expectedDescription: The nodocite experimenter attacks all creatures adjacent to it with its scalpels in a rapid and wild assault, dealing @Damage[1d4[slashing]] damage to all creatures within reach (@Check[reflex|dc:13|basic] save).

bYzdDu0dcWV6wMyQ.name: 节点体实验员 Nodocite Experimenter

items.name: 电磁定位
items.description: 该生物能感知活物发出的电场，无需使用视觉就能精确瞄准活物。
items.expectedDescription: The creature can sense the electric field given off by living creatures, allowing them to precisely target living creatures without using visual means.

items.name: 攫取跃击
items.description: 吉伦达尔跳跃至多等于其速度的距离，随后尝试运动检定，对触手触及范围内的一个目标进行[[/act grapple]]。大成功时，目标还会被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}。
items.expectedDescription: The girendal Leaps up to its Speed, and then makes an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] a target within reach of its tentacles. On a critical success the target is additionally knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

items.name: 水上行走（恒定）
items.description:
目标能在水和其他液体的表面行走，不会沉入其中。它可以自愿进入水下，但此时必须正常游泳。该法术不提供水下呼吸能力。

升阶（4环）法术射程增至30尺，持续时间增至1小时，且你能以至多10个生物为目标。
items.expectedDescription:
The target can walk on the surface of water and other liquids without falling through. It can go underwater if it wishes, but in that case it must Swim normally. This spell doesn't grant the ability to breathe underwater.

Heightened (4th) The spell's range increases to 30 feet, the duration increases to 1 hour, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

items.description:
需求一个@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{麻痹}、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}的生物位于节点体监禁者15尺内

效果节点体监禁者尝试吸入符合需求的生物。目标必须尝试@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免。失败时，目标被拉入一个透明聚合物球内的微型口袋维度，存放于节点体监禁者的背部舱室。

每个聚合物球重轻负载，内含独立的口袋维度，同一时间能容纳一个任意体型的生物。球内的生物处于停滞状态，不受时间流逝和濒死的影响，在释放前无法行动。节点体监禁者的背部舱室能存放任意数量的聚合物球。节点体监禁者被摧毁时，会自动使用出货，排出背部舱室内的全部聚合物球。

节点体监禁者触及范围内的生物可以尝试[[/act force-open skill=athletics dc=15]]{运动}检定来破拆，或尝试[[/act disable-device skill=computers dc=15]]{计算机}、[[/act disable-device skill=crafting dc=15]]{工艺}或[[/act disable-device skill=thievery dc=15]]{贼活}检定来解除装置。成功时，改为使节点体监禁者立即使用出货，排出一个聚合物球；大成功时排出两个，而非通常的效果。它会排出最近装入生物的聚合物球。

持有聚合物球的生物可以用一个具有操作特征的单动作，将球掷至至多20尺外，使球内的生物出现在球相邻的空间，恢复通常的体型，以及被捕入球中时的状况。
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} creature is within 15 feet of the nodocite incarcerator

Effect The nodocite incarcerator attempts to inhale the required creature. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save. On a failure, they're pulled into a miniaturized pocket dimension in a clear polymer ball and stored in the nodocite incarcerator's dorsal chamber.

Each polymer ball weighs light Bulk and contains an individual pocket dimension that can hold one creature of any size at a time. Creatures inside are held in stasis, immune to the effects of time and dying, and are unable to act until released. A nodocite incarcerator can store an unlimited number of polymer balls in its dorsal chamber. When a nodocite incarcerator is destroyed, it automatically Vends all the polymer balls in its dorsal chamber.

A creature within reach of the nodocite incarcerator can attempt a [[/act force-open skill=athletics dc=15]]{Athletics} check to Force Open or a [[/act disable-device skill=computers dc=15]]{Computers}, [[/act disable-device skill=crafting dc=15]]{Crafting}, or [[/act disable-device skill=thievery dc=15]]{Thievery} check to Disable Device; on a success, rather than the usual effects, the nodocite incarcerator immediately Vends one polymer ball (or two polymer balls on a critical success). It Vends the most recently filled polymer ball.

A creature holding a polymer ball can throw the polymer ball up to 20 feet away as a single action with the manipulate trait, releasing the contained creature into an adjacent space, restored to their normal size and in the state they were when they were captured in the polymer ball.
