items.name: 血唤同血
items.description: 血生猎犬受到其他生物血液的吸引。30尺内所有正在受到持续流血伤害的生物受到@Damage[1d4[void]]伤害。然后，血生猎犬传送至一个以此方式受伤生物相邻的未占据空间。
items.expectedDescription: The bloodspawned hound is drawn to the blood of other creatures. All creatures within 30 feet that are taking persistent bleed damage are dealt @Damage[1d4[void]] damage. The bloodspawned hound then teleports to an unoccupied space adjacent to a creature damaged this way.

items.name: 闪现。重置。
items.description:
触发一个生物进入该危害的任意区域

效果现实曲织使时间线不断闪现并重置，大约每六秒一次，令触发生物在时间中来回闪烁。该生物必须进行@Check[will|dc:20]豁免。该危害投掷先攻，并随机决定一个区域（A1至A5）启用。

大成功触发生物利用时间闪现获得优势；每轮在自己回合中进行的第一次检定，都可以掷两次并取较好结果，直到该危害被战胜。这是幸运效应。

成功触发生物不受影响。

失败每轮在自己回合中进行的第一次检定，触发生物都必须掷两次并取较差结果，直到该危害被战胜。这是厄运效应。

大失败如同失败，但触发生物必须为每次检定掷两次。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters any area of the hazard

Effect The reality warp causes the timeline to repeatedly blip and reset, approximately every six seconds, causing the triggering creature to flicker back and forth in time. They must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. The hazard rolls initiative and one area (A1–A5) becomes active, determined randomly.

Critical Success The triggering creature uses the time blip to their advantage; on the first check they attempt on their turn each round, they can roll twice and take the better result, until the hazard is defeated. This is a fortune effect.

Success The triggering creature is unaffected.

Failure On the first check the triggering creature attempts on their turn each round, they must roll twice and take the worse result, until the hazard is defeated. This is a misfortune effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except the triggering creature must roll every check twice.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Reality glitches, causing one of the camp's five areas to jump backward and forward in time, buildings and people alike dissolving in the temporal chaos.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 现实出现故障，使营地五个区域之一在时间中来回跳跃，建筑与人员一同消解在时序混乱中。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:18], @Check[nature|dc:18], @Check[occultism|dc:18], or @Check[religion|dc:18] (trained) to magically reinforce Akiton's reality, or @Check[intimidation|dc:19] (trained) to impose your will on the reality warp; must be in the hazard's active area to Disable it.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:18]、@Check[nature|dc:18]、@Check[occultism|dc:18]或@Check[religion|dc:18]（受训）以魔法加固阿基顿的现实；或@Check[intimidation|dc:19]（受训）以将自身意志施加于现实扭曲；必须身处危害当前活跃的区域才能解除它。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) With its first action, reality warps in the hazard's active area, dealing @Damage[(1d10+6)[force]] damage to all creatures in that area (@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic] save). With its second action, the active hazard moves to a different area, determined randomly. Any creatures in this new active area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. On a failure, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as they try to process the changing reality; on a critical failure, they are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）第一个动作使危害当前活跃区域内的现实扭曲，对区域内所有生物造成@Damage[(1d10+6)[force]]伤害，目标进行@Check[fortitude|dc:20|basic]豁免。第二个动作使活跃的危害移至随机决定的另一区域。新活跃区域内的任何生物都必须尝试@Check[will|dc:20]豁免。失败时，它们试图理解不断变化的现实，因此@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑1}；大失败时，还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}1轮。

items.name: 升温！
items.description:
触发集成体格雷米克投掷先攻

效果排放口升温，从四个各为10尺方格的排放口中喷出蒸汽。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Gremmik Integrated rolls initiative

Effect The vents heat up, releasing a puff of steam from each of the four 10-foot square vents. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Gremmik Integrated blasts the four 10-foot square grates with steam from underneath, using the water that cools the servers.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 集成体格雷米克利用冷却服务器的水，从下方通过四个10尺见方的格栅喷出蒸汽。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:18] or @Check[engineering-lore|dc:18] to cover the vents or @Check[thievery|dc:20] to Disable the mechanics; four total successes are required as each grate must be disabled. Once a grate is disabled, it no longer deals damage.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:18]或@Check[engineering-lore|dc:18]以覆盖排气口；或@Check[thievery|dc:20]以解除机构；每个格栅都需要解除，因此总计需要四次成功。格栅被解除后就不再造成伤害。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: All creatures in or above the four 10-foot square vents are dealt @Damage[4d4[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect] save)
cnText_system_details_routine.text: 位于四个10尺见方的排气口内或其上方的所有生物，受到@Damage[4d4[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，并进行@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect]豁免

items.name: 重力消退
items.description:
触发彼岸惧魔出现

效果地面震动，细小的岩石与水晶碎片浮至空中。该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The beyond terror appears

Effect The ground shakes and small pieces of rock and crystal levitate into the air. The hazard rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The beyond terror's entrance into reality negates gravity in a localized area, resembling the zero-g vacuum of space.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 彼岸惧魔进入现实，使局部区域失去重力，如同太空中的零重力真空。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:13] or @Check[occultism|dc:13] (trained) to temporarily counter the hazard's gravitational influence, preventing it from changing the gravity level on its next turn. The hazard is permanently disabled when the beyond terror is defeated.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:13]或@Check[occultism|dc:13]（受训）以暂时抵消危害的重力影响，阻止其在下一回合改变重力等级。彼岸惧魔被击败时，危害永久解除。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) On each of the hazard's turns, gravity in its affected area (indicated by a dotted line on the map) alters by one step, going from normal to low on turn 1 and low to zero on turn 2. From turn 3 onward, the area shifts between zero and low gravity on each alternating turn, and continues to do so until the hazard is disabled.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害的每回合，其影响区域内的重力变化一级，地图以虚线标示：第1回合由标准重力降为低重力，第2回合由低重力降为零重力。第3回合起，区域每回合在零重力和低重力间交替，直到危害被解除。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard doesn't reset once the beyond terror is defeated.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 彼岸惧魔被击败后，危害不会重置。

items.name: 喷射脓液
items.description:
触发一个生物进入房间内被灵液淹没的空间之一

效果该危害向触发生物喷射一股腐蚀性液体和脓液，造成@Damage[(2d6+3)[acid]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters one of the ichor-submerged spaces in this room

Effect The hazard sprays a stream of caustic fluids and pus at the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[(2d6+3)[acid]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The inflamed walls of this chamber violently contract, squirting out caustic fluids and pus.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 舱室发炎的墙壁剧烈收缩，喷出腐蚀性液体与脓液。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[medicine|dc:12] (trained) to ease the inflammation, or @Check[diplomacy|dc:13] or @Check[occultism|dc:13] (trained) to psychically soothe the structure; @Check[acrobatics|dc:16] or @Check[stealth|dc:16] to move through the area without triggering its spray (this doesn't disable the hazard).
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[medicine|dc:12]（受训）以缓解炎症；或@Check[diplomacy|dc:13]或@Check[occultism|dc:13]（受训）以心灵力量安抚该结构；@Check[acrobatics|dc:16]或@Check[stealth|dc:16]以穿过区域而不触发喷射，这不会解除危害。

items.name: 汲取能量
items.description:
触发脱线残影被一件消耗充能的远程武器命中，且该武器电池至少还剩1充能

效果脱线残影从武器中吸取能量，使其额外消耗1充能。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The unspooled vestige is hit by a ranged weapon that uses charges and has at least 1 charge remaining in its battery

Effect The unspooled vestige pulls energy from the weapon, causing it to expend an additional charge.

items.name: 滑出现实
items.description: 回合结束时，脱线残影必须进行@Check[flat|dc:11]。失败时，它稍稍滑出现实，受到@Damage[1d4[force]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}状态，持续至其下一回合开始。
items.expectedDescription: At the end of its turn, the unspooled vestige must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a failure, it slips slightly out of reality. It takes @Damage[1d4[force]] damage, and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the start of its next turn.

items.name: 缠结
items.description: 脱线残影的丝线会缠住命中的生物。该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}状态；它并不处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{禁足}状态，但不能移出脱线残影丝线的范围。脱线残影可以用一次运动检定尝试对每个被缠住的生物进行[[/act reposition]]，将结果分别与每个生物的强韧DC比较。对于脱线残影的多次攻击减值而言，这么做只算一次尝试。[[/act escape dc=18]]的DC为18，或生物可以对抗AC 15进行打击并造成至少3点挥砍伤害来斩断丝线。这不会对脱线残影造成伤害。只要生物仍位于丝线范围内，脱线残影就能在不结束缠结的情况下移动。
items.expectedDescription: A unspooled vestige filament becomes entangled with a creature it hits. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}; they're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but they can't move beyond the range of the unspooled vestige's filament. The unspooled vestige can attempt to [[/act reposition]] each entangled creature with a single Athletics check, which they compare against each creature's Fortitude DC. Doing so only counts as one attempt for the unspooled vestige's multiple attack penalty. The DC to [[/act escape dc=18]] is 18, or a creature can sever the filament with a Strike against AC 15 that deals at least 3 slashing damage. This deals no damage to the unspooled vestige. The unspooled vestige can move without ending the entanglement as long as the creature remains within the filament's range.

items.name: 脱线
items.description: 该生物赖以存在的现实织物开始磨损散线。脱线残影必须进行@Check[fortitude|dc:16]豁免。失败时，它受到@Damage[1d4[force]]伤害；大失败时则受到@Damage[1d6[force]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription: The fabric of the creature's reality begins to fray. The unspooled vestige must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:16] save. On a failure it takes @Damage[1d4[force]] damage, or @Damage[1d6[force]] damage on a critical failure.

9Cm3LHfWDmMleLgn.name: 绍贝德人的愤慨 Shobhad Indignation

items.name: 败者之号
items.description:
触发一个既非精类也非绍贝德人的生物经过房间中央

效果精魂愤怒地嚎叫，对触发生物造成@Damage[2d4[mental]]伤害（@Check[will|dc:20|basic]豁免）。大失败时，该生物还陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{耳聋}状态，持续1轮。然后，该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A non-fey, non-shobhad creature passes the room's center

Effect The spirits howl in rage, dealing @Damage[2d4[mental]] damage to the triggering creature (@Check[will|dc:20|basic] save). On a critical failure, that creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round. The hazard then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The paintings weep blackness outward until they create shadows from floor to ceiling.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 画作向外流出漆黑之物，直到形成从地板延伸至天花板的阴影。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[acrobatics|dc:20] (trained) to divert the energy of the spirits against each other, @Check[athletics|dc:18] (trained) to [[/act grapple]] the spirits, or @Check[religion|dc:18] or @Check[occultism|dc:18] (trained) to soothe the restless souls; two successes are required to disable the hazard.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[acrobatics|dc:20]（受训）以引导精魂能量彼此对抗；@Check[athletics|dc:18]（受训）以对精魂[[/act grapple]]；或@Check[religion|dc:18]或@Check[occultism|dc:18]（受训）以安抚不安的灵魂；解除危害需要两次成功。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
(1 action) Shadowy hands lunge from the walls to drag down creatures in the room. The hazard attempts an Athletics check with a [[/gmr 1d20+12 #Athletics]]{+12} modifier against the Fortitude DC of up to two different creatures in the room.

Critical Success The target takes @Damage[(2d10+4)[bludgeoning]] damage, is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and is pushed 10 feet toward the nearest wall. It can't breathe or speak until it ends the prone condition.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1d10+4)[bludgeoning]] damage and is pushed 5 feet toward the nearest wall.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
（1个动作）阴影之手从墙壁扑出，将房内生物向下拖拽。危害尝试运动检定，调整值为[[/gmr 1d20+12 #Athletics]]{+12}，对抗房内至多两个不同生物的强韧DC。

大成功目标受到@Damage[(2d10+4)[bludgeoning]]伤害，被击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，并向最近的墙壁推近10尺。在结束倒地状态前，它无法呼吸或说话。

成功目标受到@Damage[(1d10+4)[bludgeoning]]伤害，并向最近的墙壁推近5尺。

items.name: 陷坑坠落
items.description:
触发一个生物走上活板门

效果触发生物落入坑中，受到坠落伤害（通常为5，但在阿基顿的低重力环境中为0），外加尖刺造成的@Damage[2d4[piercing]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]豁免）。该生物可以使用[[/act grab-an-edge dc=16]]反应避免坠落。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature walks onto the trapdoor

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes fall damage (typically 5; but 0 in Akiton's low gravity), plus an additional @Damage[2d4[piercing]] damage from the spikes (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save). The creature can use the [[/act grab-an-edge dc=16]] reaction to avoid falling.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Metal caution-taped doors cover a 10-foot deep pit full of dull metal spikes.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 贴有警示胶带的金属门覆盖着一个10尺深的坑，坑内布满钝金属刺。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[thievery|dc:12] to lock or close the trap door
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[thievery|dc:12]以锁住或关闭活板门

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 生物仍可能跌入陷阱，但必须手动重置活板门，陷阱才能再次隐藏。

items.name: 附着
items.description: 灵液螨咬住比自己大的生物时，口器会附着在该生物身上。这类似于攫抓该生物，但灵液螨会随该生物移动，而非将其固定在原地。附着期间，灵液螨处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态。
items.expectedDescription: When the ichor mite bites a creature larger than itself, its mouth parts attach it to that creature. This is similar to Grabbing the creature, but the ichor mite moves with the creature rather than holding it in place. The ichor mite is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attached.

items.name: 闪烁耀光
items.description:
触发集成体格雷米克投掷先攻

效果全息影像剧烈闪烁，亮度增强。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger Gremmik Integrated rolls initiative

Effect The holograms flicker wildly and increase in brightness. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Gremmik Integrated uses the holographic display from the center platform to distract and confuse one PC
cnText_system_details_description.text: 集成体格雷米克利用中央平台的全息显示，分散并扰乱一名PC的注意力

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:18] to reprogram the display or @Check[thievery|dc:20] to turn it off entirely; three total successes are required.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:18]以重编显示；或@Check[thievery|dc:20]以完全关闭它；总计需要三次成功。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected:
The holographic display targets one creature within 20 feet of the platform, quickly displaying and changing graphs, logos, and videos. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20|options:inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:dazzled] save, with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the holographic display and is immune to its effects.

Success The creature is unaffected by the holographic display.

Failure The creature is distracted by the holographic display and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for one round.

Critical Failure The creature is fully invested in the information being displayed and is off-guard and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for one round.

Note: A DC for this ability was not provided by Paizo. A value of 20 has been used following the hazard building rules.
cnText_system_details_routine.text:
全息显示以平台20尺内的一个生物为目标，快速显示并切换图表、标志和视频。该生物必须尝试@Check[will|dc:20|options:inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:dazzled]豁免，结果如下。

大成功该生物不受全息显示影响，并免疫其效果。

成功该生物不受全息显示影响。

失败该生物被全息显示分散注意力，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}1轮。

大失败该生物完全沉浸于显示的信息，措手不及并@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}1轮。

注：Paizo未为此能力提供DC。模组依据危害构建规则采用了20。

items.name: 血液感知
items.description: 血生尖啸者能在列出的距离内，以不精确感官侦测生物体内的血液。对正在流血的生物而言，这是精确感官。
items.expectedDescription: A bloodspawned screecher can detect blood inside creatures' bodies as an imprecise sense at the listed range. This is a precise sense against creatures actively bleeding.

items.name: 厉啸
items.description: 血生尖啸者发出令人失去方向感的@Template[type:cone|distance:15]厉啸，对区域内每个生物造成@Damage[1d6[sonic]|options:area-damage]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:14|basic]豁免）。如果血生尖啸者以厉啸对一个正在受到持续流血伤害的生物造成伤害，此次厉啸不计入使用频率。
items.expectedDescription: The bloodspawned screecher releases a disorienting shriek in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] that deals @Damage[1d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature within the area (@Check[fortitude|dc:14|basic] save). If the bloodspawned screecher deals damage to a creature taking persistent bleed damage with Shriek, this use of Shriek doesn't count toward its frequency.

items.name: 加速模拟
items.description:
触发一个生物进入剧场

效果陷阱以令人眩晕的速度启动一连串模拟，每次都与上一次略有不同。区域B6内所有能看见的生物都必须进行@Check[will|dc:20]豁免。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。

大成功目标不受影响。

成功目标处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心1}状态，持续1轮。

失败目标受到@Damage[2d4[mental]]伤害，并陷入恶心1。

大失败目标受到@Damage[4d4[mental]]伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{恶心2}状态。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the theater

Effect The trap launches a series of simulations at a dizzying pace, each slightly different from the previous one. All creatures in area B6 who can see must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. The trap the rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target takes @Damage[2d4[mental]] damage and is sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[4d4[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A rapid sequence of dizzying simulations plays throughout the theater.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 剧场内快速播放一连串令人眩晕的模拟场景。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:17], @Check[nature|dc:17], @Check[occultism|dc:17], or @Check[religion|dc:17] (trained) to siphon the magical energy, or @Check[thievery|dc:19] (trained) to disrupt the holograms, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 16)
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:17]、@Check[nature|dc:17]、@Check[occultism|dc:17]或@Check[religion|dc:17]（受训）以抽走魔法能量；或@Check[thievery|dc:19]（受训）以扰乱全息影像；或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{解除魔法}（2环；反制DC 16）

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) The hazard plays a new simulation each round, forcing all creatures who can sense it to attempt a new save.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害每轮播放一个新的模拟场景，迫使所有能感知场景的生物再次尝试豁免。

items.name: 激光冲击
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至炮塔30尺内

效果陷阱对该生物进行激光打击。然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the turret

Effect The trap makes a laser Strike against the creature. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A ceiling mounted turret fires a laser when intruders approach area B13.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 入侵者靠近区域B13时，天花板上安装的炮塔发射激光。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:18] (trained) to reprogram the turret, or @Check[crafting|dc:17] (trained) to cut power to the turret, or @Check[thievery|dc:16] (trained) to disable the turret
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:18]（受训）以重编炮塔；或@Check[crafting|dc:17]（受训）以切断炮塔电源；或@Check[thievery|dc:16]（受训）以解除炮塔

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap makes three laser Strikes, each targeting a different creature unless there are fewer than three creatures in range.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱进行三次激光打击，每次针对不同生物，除非射程内不足三个生物。

JgNhb5TnOEFs6RKF.name: 摆木陷阱 Swinging Log Trap

items.name: 摆动
items.description:
触发一个生物进入指定的10尺方形区域

效果原木沿其摆动轨迹扫过，对触发生物进行原木打击。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the designated 10-foot square area

Effect The log swings along its course, making a log Strike against the triggering creature.

items.name: 原木
items.description: 外加击至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}
items.expectedDescription: Plus knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A log hung up in the trees swings down in a wide arc when a creature enters the designated @Template[square|distance:10] area.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 生物进入指定的@Template[square|distance:10]区域时，悬挂于树上的原木沿宽阔弧线荡下。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[survival|dc:14] or @Check[thievery|dc:14] to safely sever the triggering pulleys and ropes.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[survival|dc:14]或@Check[thievery|dc:14]以安全切断触发滑轮和绳索。

items.name: 散射光线
items.description:
触发棱面守卫受到具有光亮特征的攻击，或激光武器组武器造成的伤害

效果棱面守卫本能地调整棱面，将光线散射至四面八方。它对触发伤害获得抗力5，与棱面守卫相邻的生物受到等于以此方式抵消伤害量的伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The facet guardian is damaged by an attack with the light trait or a weapon from the laser group

Effect The facet guardian reflexively positions its facets to scatter the light in all directions. It gains resistance 5 to the triggering damage and creatures adjacent to the facet guardian take damage equal to the amount of damage resisted this way (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]).

items.name: 炫目反射
items.description: 棱面守卫的聚焦反射打击大成功时，目标必须进行@Check[fortitude|dc:18]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{目眩}状态，持续1轮。
items.expectedDescription: When the facet guardian critically succeeds on a focused reflection Strike, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:18] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

items.name: 刃缘滑行
items.description: 棱面守卫以一个棱面刀刃般的边缘滑行，快速向前冲刺。它移动至多相当于其速度的距离，并对移动途中经过其相邻空间的任意数量生物，各进行一次镜刃打击。这些攻击计入棱面守卫的多次攻击减值，但减值在所有攻击完成后才增加。
items.expectedDescription: The facet guardian dashes forward quickly, sliding on the knife-edge of one of its facets. It moves up to its Speed and makes one mirror's edge Strike against any number of creatures it passes adjacent to during its movement. These attacks contribute to the facet guardian's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty does not increase until all attacks are complete.

items.name: 平板折装
items.description: 棱面守卫迅速展开，贴着平坦表面收纳，或重新折叠为类人生物形态。该表面必须平坦，且足以容纳守卫的展开形态，至少为5尺乘10尺，但可以朝向任意方向。处于展开形态时，棱面守卫除用平板折装重新折叠外，不能采取任何动作，且冒充无生命壁画的欺骗DC提高至DC 22。
items.expectedDescription: The facet guardian quickly unfolds for storage against a flat surface or refolds itself into humanoid shape. The surface must be flat and large enough to contain the guardian in its unfolded state, at least 5 feet by 10 feet, though it can be oriented in any direction. When in unfolded form, the facet guardian cannot take any action except Flat-Pack to refold, and its Deception DC to Impersonate an inanimate mural increase to DC 22.

NtGdK8tDXRVVnPx6.name: 埃洛维的干扰 Elovai's Interference

items.name: 愚蠢入侵者
items.description:
触发玩家角色显现在埃洛维的心灵风暴中

效果埃洛维嘲笑玩家角色愚蠢的入侵，笑声愈发强烈，直到猛烈震动玩家角色脚下的平台。每个身处平台上的生物必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:22]豁免。然后，该危害投掷先攻。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}状态，持续至其下一回合结束。

失败该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}状态。

大失败该生物倒地，并受到@Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The PCs manifest in Elovai's psychic storm

Effect Elovai laughs at the PCs' foolish intrusion, the sound growing in intensity until it violently shakes the very platforms the PCs are standing on. Each creature on a platform must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22] save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of their next turn.

Failure The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature falls prone and takes @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]] damage.

items.name: 虚假显现
items.description: 埃洛维使一个真实、未被占据的平台隐形，或让一个虚假的幻象平台出现。与虚假平台，或隐形平台所在空间进行互动的生物，可以立即尝试@Check[will|dc:22]豁免以识破此变化。此识破检定大成功的生物，还会获得一次解除成功。
items.expectedDescription: Elovai either causes a real, unoccupied platform to become invisible, or she causes a false, illusory platform to appear. A creature who Interacts with the false platform or with the space where the invisible platform is may immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:22] save to disbelieve the change. A creature who critically succeeds on this check to disbelieve also earns one Disable success.

items.name: 恶意之风
items.description: 埃洛维在单个生物的位置骤然显现一阵强风。该生物必须成功通过@Check[fortitude|dc:22]豁免，否则向埃洛维选择的方向被推10尺。大失败时，她可以改为将其推动至多20尺。将因这次强制移动而从平台上掉落的生物，可以尝试[[/act grab-an-edge dc=22]]。
items.expectedDescription: Elovai manifests a sudden gust of wind localized on a single creature. That creature must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save or be pushed 10 feet in a direction of Elovai's choice. On a critical failure, she can instead push them up to 20 feet. A creature who would fall off a platform due to this forced movement may attempt to [[/act grab-an-edge dc=22]].

items.name: 平台消解
items.description:
埃洛维使心灵风暴中的一个浮空平台爆散为其组成原子，数秒后重新聚合。平台上的所有生物必须进行@Check[reflex|dc:22]豁免，结果如下。

大成功该生物利用爆散的力量向上跃起，滞空时间足以让平台在其下方重新聚合，然后轻轻落在原位。

成功该生物及时跳起，避免坠落，却被消解的力量扰乱平衡，回落原位时处于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}状态。

失败该生物从平台上坠落，落入风暴，如地形部分所述。

大失败如同失败，但该生物还因消解的力量受到@Damage[(2d8+7)[piercing]]伤害。
items.expectedDescription:
Elovai causes one of the floating platforms in the psychic storm to burst apart into its component atoms, then reform a few seconds later. All creatures on the platform must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:22] save with the following results.

Critical Success The creature uses the force of the burst to propel themselves upwards long enough for the platform to reform beneath them, then the creature lands gently in the same location they started in.

Success The creature jumps up in time to avoid falling, but is thrown off balance by the force of the dissolution and lands @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} in the same location they started in.

Failure The creature falls off the platform and through the storm, as described in terrain.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature additionally takes @Damage[(2d8+7)[piercing]] damage from the force of the dissolution.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Elovai laughs maniacally as the whole psychic storm bends to her will.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 埃洛维狂笑着，让整场心灵风暴屈从其意志。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:20] (trained) or @Check[occultism|dc:20] (trained) to magically disrupt Elovai's control, @Check[nature|dc:21] (expert), @Check[religion|dc:21] (expert), @Check[survival|dc:21] (expert), or @Check[thievery|dc:21] (trained) to understand and unravel the underpinnings of the psychic storm, or @Check[will|dc:23] save to disbelieve Elovai's illusions; three total successes are required to disable the hazard.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:20]（受训）或@Check[occultism|dc:20]（受训）以魔法干扰埃洛维的控制；@Check[nature|dc:21]（专家）、@Check[religion|dc:21]（专家）、@Check[survival|dc:21]（专家）或@Check[thievery|dc:21]（受训），以理解并瓦解心灵风暴的根基；或@Check[will|dc:23]豁免以识破埃洛维的幻术；解除危害总计需要三次成功。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The hazard uses Platform Dissolution, then alternates between using either False Manifestation or Malevolent Wind.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）危害先使用平台消解，随后在虚假显现与恶意之风之间交替使用。

RGpcMznWR60wmvxU.name: 爆炸水果陷阱 Exploding Fruit Trap

items.name: 投弹！
items.description:
触发一个生物进入指定方格

效果投石机向空中发射十二颗特维卢果（twi-lw），对触发生物及所有其他生物造成@Damage[2d4[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]伤害，范围为以触发生物为中心的@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]。目标生物可以进行@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic]豁免。豁免失败的生物还会被黏稠的水果包裹，陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}状态，持续[[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4轮}（大失败时1分钟）。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature enters the designated square

Effect The catapult launches a dozen twi-lw fruits through the air, dealing @Damage[2d4[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to the triggering creature and all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] centered on the triggering creature. Targeted creatures can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:16|basic] save. A creature that fails their save is additionally coated in sticky fruit, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} (1 minute on a critical failure).

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A makeshift catapult launches a dozen twi-lw fruits at all creatures in a wide area when a creature enters a selected @Template[square|distance:5].
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个生物进入所选@Template[square|distance:5]时，简易投石机向大片区域内的所有生物发射十二个特维卢果。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[survival|dc:14] or @Check[thievery|dc:14] to disable the triggering pressure plate.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[survival|dc:14]或@Check[thievery|dc:14]以解除触发压力板。

items.name: 辐射感知
items.description: 光簇体能在60尺内以不精确感官感知辐射，包括活物产生的微量辐射
items.expectedDescription: A phosimplex can sense radiation within 60 feet as an imprecise sense, including minute traces of radiation generated by living creatures

items.name: 太阳爆炸
items.description: 光簇体死亡时，躯体再也无法容纳储存的太阳能，因而爆炸，造成@Damage[1d10[fire]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]内的每个生物（@Check[reflex|dc:14|basic]豁免）。
items.expectedDescription: When a phosimplex dies, its body can no longer contain the solar energy stored within. It explodes, dealing @Damage[1d10[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:14|basic] save).

items.name: 解结伸展
items.description: 光簇体能拉直纠缠的触须，伸长躯体，使自身显得大得多。光簇体变为中型，其触须打击获得15尺触及，并获得挥砍伤害弱点2。它可以重复此动作，恢复原本的体型与外形。
items.expectedDescription: A phosimplex can straighten its tangle of tentacles, elongating its body to appear much larger. The phosimplex becomes Medium, its tentacle Strikes gain a reach of 15 feet, and it gains weakness 2 to slashing damage. It can repeat this action to return to its base size and shape.

items.name: 投掷糖豆
items.description:
触发一个生物接近糖豆机周围30尺内

效果糖豆机对触发生物进行软糖豆打击，然后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature comes within 30 feet of the bean machine

Effect The bean machine makes a gummi bean Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A large machine that breaks down anything into its atomic parts and 3D prints edible gummies. Unfortunately, it’s malfunctioning.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一台大型机器能将任何东西分解为原子组成，再以3D打印制造可食用软糖。不幸的是，它发生了故障。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:14], @Check[nature|dc:14], @Check[occultism|dc:14], or @Check[religion|dc:14] (trained) to magically end the possession, or @Check[crafting|dc:15] or @Check[thievery|dc:15] to manually recalibrate the machine; three total successes are required to disable the trap
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:14]、@Check[nature|dc:14]、@Check[occultism|dc:14]或@Check[religion|dc:14]（受训）以魔法结束附身；或@Check[crafting|dc:15]或@Check[thievery|dc:15]以手动重新校准机器；解除陷阱总计需要三次成功

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The bean machine makes three gummi bean Strikes, each targeting different creatures if possible.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）糖豆机进行三次软糖豆打击，尽可能选择不同生物为目标。

items.name: 瓦解入侵者
items.description:
触发一个生物移动至装置30尺内

效果陷阱对该生物进行降解光束打击；然后，陷阱投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature moves within 30 feet of the device

Effect The trap makes a degradation beam Strike against the creature; the trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A levitating cube that hums with power fires corrosive beams at intruders.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一个悬浮立方体因能量而嗡鸣，向入侵者发射腐蚀光束。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:18] or @Check[occultism|dc:18] (trained) to disrupt the device's magical currents, @Check[computers|dc:19] (trained) to reprogram the device, or @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to disable the turret
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:18]或@Check[occultism|dc:18]（受训）以扰乱装置的魔法流；@Check[computers|dc:19]（受训）以重编装置；或@Check[thievery|dc:17]（受训）以解除炮塔

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (3 actions) The trap makes a degradation beam Strike against up to three creatures in range or three Strikes against one creature in range if it has no additional targets.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （3个动作）陷阱对射程内至多三个生物各进行一次降解光束打击；如果没有其他目标，则对射程内的一个生物进行三次打击。

items.name: 启动循环
items.description:
触发一对心灵锚之间的连接被切断

效果嵌在地板中的魔法科技面板充能，发出越来越响、几乎令人难以忍受的尖锐嗡鸣。伴随撕裂耳膜的尖啸，充能触须从设施的墙壁、天花板和地板中显现。区域A2和A5内的所有生物受到@Damage[(1d10+4)[sonic]]伤害（@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic]豁免）。该危害投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The connection between one pair of psychic anchors is severed

Effect Magitech panels embedded in the floor energize with a high-pitched whine that increases in volume until becoming nearly unbearable. With an ear-splitting screech, energized tendrils manifest from the walls, ceiling, and floor of the complex. All creatures in area A2 and A5 take @Damage[(1d10+4)[sonic]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic] save). The hazard rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The magitech mechanisms that control the works of the complex in the heart of the Wreck attempt to restore the severed connection between the psychic anchors, flooding the area with dangerous energetic tendrils.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 控制残骸核心设施运作的魔法科技机构，试图恢复心灵锚之间被切断的链接，使危险的能量卷须充满区域。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:18], @Check[nature|dc:18], @Check[occultism|dc:18], or @Check[religion|dc:18] to disrupt the flow of magical energy in the floor panels; @Check[crafting|dc:20] or @Check[thievery|dc:20] to disable the magitech floor panels; @Check[computers|dc:22] to deactivate the subroutine (must be attempted at one of the computers in the psychic anchor rooms). Three total successes required.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:18]、@Check[nature|dc:18]、@Check[occultism|dc:18]或@Check[religion|dc:18]以扰乱地板面板中的魔法能量流；@Check[crafting|dc:20]或@Check[thievery|dc:20]以解除魔法科技地板面板；@Check[computers|dc:22]以停用子程序，必须在心灵锚房间的一台计算机上尝试。总计需要三次成功。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) The hazard makes three probing lash strikes against randomly chosen PCs in area A2 and A5. On the 5th round and every 5 rounds thereafter, the one deactivated psychic anchor becomes active and, if both psychic anchors in that pair are active, the energy beam connecting them is restored. A broken or destroyed psychic anchor can't be activated in this way.

micllXbcz1eBcAoz.name: 火微灵 Fire Wisp
micllXbcz1eBcAoz.publicNotes:
火微灵是由火焰和灰烬组成的炽热球体，持续噼啪作响，因热量而闪烁。它们无忧无虑、热闹喧哗，而且行动果断，有时甚至鲁莽。

微灵是元素位面形成时诞生的微小元素生物。最初的微灵组成不断变化的交响乐团，在内环宇宙漫游，每次相遇都会交换成员。这些自由微灵的交响乐团将彼此的共鸣汇成音乐。但邪恶的元素领主发现其共鸣的价值后，便捕获整个交响乐团，令它们充当仆役。

微灵会与彼此及身边的生物协调共振，因此天生就是善于支援的盟友。自由的微灵仍在内环宇宙和宇宙中漫游，但通常很害羞，会躲避陌生人。不过，它们乐意为善待自己的生物效劳。微灵尤其容易被研习元素魔法的施法者吸引；它们通常远远观察，有时也会接近那些看起来安全的人，成为魔宠或伙伴。

自由的微灵相遇后，几乎立刻就会亲近起来。遇到其他元素的微灵时，它们尤其兴奋，毫无不同位面元素生物之间有时会表现出的敌意。相反，它们会兴奋地共舞，发出共鸣，隐约回响着远古交响乐团的乐声。

items.expectedDescription: The fire wisp ignores the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition from smoke.

使用此反应的微灵永久被摧毁，只能通过@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{祈愿术}仪式或类似的强大效果复原。如果某个能力会阻止微灵被摧毁，例如召唤的微灵只会被解消，和声要义便没有效果。

A wisp that uses this reaction is permanently destroyed, and they can be restored by only a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual or similarly powerful effect. If an ability would prevent the wisp's destruction (for instance, if the wisp is summoned and would merely be dismissed), Accord Essence has no effect.

区域内的生物使用具有火特征的效果时，其攻击检定和伤害检定获得+1状态加值；同时具有元素和火特征的生物，其所有攻击检定和伤害检定均获得此加值。

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 minute.

items.name: 蒸汽清洗
items.description:
触发一个生物在U形走廊内结束移动

效果陷阱向走廊喷出浓密的蒸汽，遮蔽视线。区域内的生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{隐蔽}，走廊外的生物对走廊内的生物具有隐蔽。陷阱随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature ends its movement in the U-shaped hall

Effect The trap sprays a dense cloud of steam in the hall, obscuring vision. Creatures in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and creatures outside the hall are concealed to those within it. The trap then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: Nozzles on the walls spray hot water, chemical sanitizers, and superheated air at all creatures entering the U-shaped hall.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 墙上喷嘴向所有进入U形走廊的生物喷洒热水、化学消毒剂和过热空气。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:14] (trained) to reprogram the system to safe levels, @Check[crafting|dc:14] (trained) to shut off the waterline, or @Check[thievery|dc:13] (trained) to cut power to the hall
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:14]（受训）以将系统重编至安全水平；@Check[crafting|dc:14]（受训）以关闭水管；或@Check[thievery|dc:13]（受训）以切断走廊电源

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) The trap sprays a powerful stream of superheated water and sanitizer at all creatures in the U-shaped hall, dealing @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning],1d4[fire]]{1d4 bludgeoning damage and 1d4 fire damage} (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save).
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）陷阱向U形走廊内所有生物喷出强劲的过热水流和消毒剂，造成@Damage[1d4[bludgeoning],1d4[fire]]{1d4钝击伤害和1d4火焰伤害}，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic]豁免。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The trap automatically deactivates and resets if there are no creatures in the area.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 区域内没有生物时，陷阱自动停用并重置。

wTNA31V4cZNUu78t.name: 现实扭曲刻法克虫 Reality-Warped Khefak

items.name: 啃食废料
items.description: 刻法克虫咀嚼一件无人持有的物体进食，每10分钟对该物体造成@Damage[4[piercing]]伤害。此伤害忽略10点硬度。如果刻法克虫每天没有花费至少1小时啃噬废料，便开始饥饿，直到花费10分钟啃噬废料。
items.expectedDescription: A khefak chews on an unattended object to feed, dealing @Damage[4[piercing]] damage every 10 minutes to the object. This damage ignores 10 points of Hardness. If a khefak doesn't spend at least 1 hour Gnawing Scrap per day, it begins to starve until it spends 10 minutes Gnawing Scrap.

items.name: 尾部爆发
items.description: 刻法克虫甩动尾部，释放一道不稳定魔法爆发，造成@Damage[3d6[acid]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:line|distance:60]，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic]豁免。它在[[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Tail Blast]]{1d4轮}内不能再次使用尾部爆发。
items.expectedDescription: The khefak flicks its tail, unleashing a blast of volatile magic that deals @Damage[3d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:line|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save). It can't use Tail Blast again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Tail Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

items.name: 废料齐射
items.description:
触发一个敌对生物移入炮塔30尺范围

效果炮塔对触发生物进行一次废弹打击，随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An enemy creature moves within 30 feet of the turret

Effect The turret makes a junkslug Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A haphazardly constructed slug thrower with a barrel of discarded munitions, nails, and shrapnel has an advanced laser targeting system to identify and attack enemies.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一台草率拼装的实弹发射器，以一桶废弃弹药、钉子和破片为弹药，配有先进激光瞄准系统，用于识别并攻击敌人。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[computers|dc:17] (trained) to override the targeting system's friend/foe profiles, @Check[crafting|dc:15] (trained) to cut the turret's power, or @Check[thievery|dc:17] (trained) to disable the turret.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[computers|dc:17]（受训）以覆盖瞄准系统的敌我识别配置；@Check[crafting|dc:15]（受训）以切断炮塔电源；或@Check[thievery|dc:17]（受训）以解除炮塔。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (2 actions) The turret makes a junkslug Strike against up to two creatures in range, or multiple Strikes against a single creature in range if it has no additional targets.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （2个动作）炮塔对射程内至多两个生物各进行一次废弹打击；如果没有其他目标，则对射程内的一个生物进行多次打击。

items.name: 伺机旋转
items.description:
触发锚定异维体将被近战或远程打击命中

需求锚定异维体察觉到了此次攻击，且对其并非@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}

效果锚定异维体旋转身体，将稳定环转到攻击路径上。触发打击的伤害由稳定环承受，而非锚定异维体。打击的所有其他效果仍会影响锚定异维体。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The anchored dimensional would be hit by a melee or ranged Strike

Requirements The anchored dimensional is aware of the attack and is not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against them

Effect The anchored dimensional spins their body, causing the stabilization ring to rotate into the way of the attack. The triggering Strike's damage is dealt to the stabilization ring, rather than the anchored dimensional. All other effects of the Strike affect the anchored dimensional.

items.name: 稳定环
items.description: 锚定异维体来自现实之间的空间，被一种名为稳定环的魔法科技装置强迫采用三维物质形态。稳定环使用锚定异维体的AC和豁免，但具有硬度3、HP 20（BT 10）。稳定环破损后，锚定异维体获得隐蔽。稳定环被摧毁后，异维体便获得自由，返回现实间那不可理解的空间。
items.expectedDescription: An anchored dimensional is a creature from between realities forced to adopt a physical, three-dimensional form via a magitech device called a stabilization ring. The stabilization ring uses the anchored dimensional's AC and saving throws, but it has hardness 3, HP 20 (BT 10). When the stabilization ring is broken, the anchored dimensional gains concealment. When the stabilization ring is destroyed, the dimensional is freed, returning home to the incomprehensible space between realities.

items.name: 狂乱抽打
items.description: 锚定异维体向四周挥击，对每个相邻敌人各进行一次棘刺鞭击打击。每次攻击都计入多重攻击减值，但要等所有攻击完成后才增加减值。
items.expectedDescription: The anchored dimensional lashes out in all directions, making a spined lash Strike against each adjacent enemy. Each attack counts toward their multiple attack penalty, but they don't increase their penalty until all these attacks have been made.

items.name: 滑越空间
items.description:
频率每轮一次

效果锚定异维体利用自己与时空间不稳定的联系避开威胁，传送到15尺内一处它能看见且未被占据的空间。
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

Effect The anchored dimensional takes advantage of its tenuous relationship with space and time to outmaneuver threats. The anchored dimensional teleports to an unoccupied space they can see within 15 feet.

items.name: 爆炸
items.description:
触发一个生物进入地雷的区域

效果地雷爆炸，造成@Damage[1d4[piercing]|options:area-damage]伤害，影响@Template[type:emanation|distance:5]内的所有生物，目标进行@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic|options:area-effect]豁免
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger a creature enters the landmine's area

Effect The landmine explodes, dealing @Damage[1d4[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:16|basic|options:area-effect] save)

cnText_system_details_description.expected: A simple landmine buried in the ground explodes when pressure is applied.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 一枚埋在地下的简易地雷，在受到压力时爆炸。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[crafting|dc:12], @Check[survival|dc:12], or @Check[thievery|dc:12] to carefully deactivate the mine's trigger
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[crafting|dc:12]、@Check[survival|dc:12]或@Check[thievery|dc:12]以小心停用地雷的触发装置

items.name: 风暴汇聚
items.description:
触发彼岸惧魔出现

效果旋转的绿色能量从世界之镜中涌出，伴随困惑与恐惧的哀号在空中翻腾。世界之镜30尺内的所有生物都会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧1}，除非通过@Check[will|dc:16]豁免。作祟随后投掷先攻。
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The beyond terror appears

Effect A swirling green energy emerges from the world mirror, roiling through the air with a wail of confusion and fear. All creatures within 30 feet of the world mirror become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} unless they succeed at a @Check[will|dc:16] save. The haunt then rolls initiative.

cnText_system_details_description.expected: The collective minds of Luvoth's sapient inhabitants lash out at the unknown in a storm of psychic confusion, fear, anger and pain.
cnText_system_details_description.text: 卢沃斯智慧居民的集体心智，在一场充满困惑、恐惧、愤怒和痛苦的心灵风暴中攻击未知事物。

cnText_system_details_disable.expected: @Check[arcana|dc:16], @Check[nature|dc:16], @Check[religion|dc:16] or @Check[occultism|dc:16] (trained) to soothe the restless emotions with prayer, meditative chanting, or magical rituals; three total checks are required to disable the hazard. The hazard is permanently disabled when the beyond terror is defeated.
cnText_system_details_disable.text: @Check[arcana|dc:16]、@Check[nature|dc:16]、@Check[religion|dc:16]或@Check[occultism|dc:16]（受训），以祈祷、冥想吟诵或魔法仪式安抚不安情绪；解除危害总计需要三次检定。彼岸惧魔被击败时，危害永久解除。

cnText_system_details_routine.expected: (1 action) On each of its turns, the hazard targets one of the PCs at random, dealing @Damage[2d4[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:16|basic] save. On a failure, the target also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}; on a critical failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}.
cnText_system_details_routine.text: （1个动作）危害在自己的每回合随机指定一名PC为目标，造成@Damage[2d4[mental]]伤害，并进行@Check[will|dc:16|basic]豁免。失败时，目标还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞1}；大失败时，则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞2}。

cnText_system_details_reset.expected: The hazard remains active as long as the beyond terror is alive and doesn't reset once it's disabled or the beyond terror is defeated.
cnText_system_details_reset.text: 只要彼岸惧魔还活着，危害就持续活跃；被解除或彼岸惧魔被击败后，不会重置。
